findings.summary: Task-scoped stage-span emission now hard-fails the stage under normal lock contention, untested
findings.suggestion: Give the attributable-start emit_event call a longer timeout (or bounded retries) before raising, and add a unit test that makes emit_event raise and asserts task_preflight/_cli_task_preflight returns rc=1 with the retry message.
findings.evidence: worktree.py:5135-5139 raises RuntimeError for any task_slug-bearing emit_event failure; stage_spans.py:144 _acquire_merge_fence(base, timeout=5.0); _FENCE_TIMEOUT=360s on the same fence.

reasoning.conclude: Normal lock contention between a concurrent land/finalize and a stage start can block the stage from starting, and the raise path has zero test coverage.

findings.summary: emit_event's new 5s fence wait can hard-fail task-preflight during a legitimate 360s land/finalize
findings.suggestion: Retry the fence acquisition for task-attributable calls up to a bound near _FENCE_TIMEOUT instead of one 5s try mapped to a fatal RuntimeError.

reasoning.conclude: The fail-closed repair is right, but a 5s budget against 360s holders makes spurious hard failures foreseeable in the supported multi-session workflow.

findings.summary: trial record-decision/reconcile exit-code set omits source_conflict, unlike sibling rejected-write reasons
findings.suggestion: Add "source_conflict" to the reason set that maps to exit code 1.
findings.evidence: not in {decision_conflict, revision_conflict, authority_required, unsupported_lock, lock_busy}

reasoning.conclude: Exit-code callers see success for a blocked source_conflict write.

findings.summary: Worktree directory name '.worktrees' is re-literalized instead of importing worktree.WORKTREE_DIR_NAME
findings.suggestion: Import WORKTREE_DIR_NAME from harness_maker.worktree and compare repo.parent.name == WORKTREE_DIR_NAME.

reasoning.conclude: Drift-prone duplicate of an existing named constant.

findings.summary: old_session_ack_required/additional_user_confirmation/additional_confirmation compare against reason strings never emitted by intent_trial.py
findings.suggestion: Drop the three sub-assertions or assert on fields intent_trial.py actually emits.

reasoning.conclude: Unfalsifiable sub-assertions inside otherwise discriminating golden rows.

findings.summary: questions=len(s.get("questions", [])) is always 0 — status()/reconcile() hardcode questions to []
findings.suggestion: Drop the questions sub-assertion or wire it to an emitted signal.

reasoning.conclude: Dead weight beside the discriminating writes/action fields.

findings.summary: invented_coverage/independent_work_may_continue read keys (coverage_accepted, halt_independent_work) intent_trial.py never emits
findings.suggestion: Remove the two derived fields or emit and assert real signals.

reasoning.conclude: Claims 'no invented coverage' and 'independent work continues' are not falsifiable by these fields.

findings.summary: [P1] 기존 순서 승인이 새 작업들의 동시 시작까지 승인해 버립니다. `ordered + later`를 반환하면서 새 suffix의 동률을 검사하지 않고, 마지막 검사도 역순만 거부합니다. 반환값이 존재하면 `_status`의 동률 검사까지 생략되어, 사용자 승인이 없는 c/d 순서를 슬러그 정렬로 확정합니다. AC-005를 위반하며 세 번째 구성원이 잘못 고정됩니다. 기존 승인 범위 밖의 동률은 별도로 차단해야 합니다. Phase 6 테스트에는 동일 시각의 후속 작업 두 개가 빠져 있습니다.
findings.evidence: 메모리 내 재현: 승인·등록된 [b,a] 뒤에 같은 시각의 acknowledged 시작 c,d를 추가하면 candidates=[b,a,c,d], reason=awaiting_reconciliation, coverage=(True, acknowledged_extension)이 나온다. reconcile은 앞의 세 후보만 취하므로 c를 확정한다.

findings.summary: [P1] 새 작업 없이 재개 로그만 추가되면 승인된 동률 순서를 다시 잃습니다. 정상적인 stage entry/resume은 ledger inventory를 변경하지만 earliest start와 후보 집합은 유지합니다. 이때 `later=[]`라는 이유로 `_reviewed_order`가 None을 반환하여 [b,a]가 [a,b]로 돌아가고 reconcile이 차단됩니다. append-only 변경에서 기존 승인 순서는 신규 작업 유무와 무관하게 유지해야 합니다. 현재 회귀 테스트는 c를 추가하는 경우만 검증하므로 이 정상적인 재개 경로를 놓칩니다.
findings.evidence: 메모리 내 재현: 승인·등록된 [b,a]의 ledger에 b의 나중 재개 start를 append했다. `_changed_reviewed_source`는 None이지만 status는 candidates=[a,b], cohort=[b,a], reason=order_conflict를 반환했다.
